name: Thief's Ring
description: (Tag:illusion)(Tag:movement)(Tag:stealth)A magical ring of a famous whimsical, mischievous thief. Holds 3 charges and recovers 1 every hour. Spend a charge to steal a carried item to your hands (better items have lower success), muffle all your noises for a minute, or boost dexterity and agility for a minute.
